description: A self-signed Tier 0 DID carrying a trust score. Per §7.3.10, Tier 0 DIDs do not participate in the trust score system at all, because there is no registry to collect or compute scores. Producing a score for a Tier 0 subject MUST be rejected. This also guards the tier model: §7.2 defines exactly three tiers (0 self-signed, 1 registry-backed, 2 audited), derived from the verification level rather than from the score.
